title.en: DeepSeek opens V4.1-Flash-1017 weights under MIT license

summary.zh: DeepSeek以MIT许可发布V4.1-Flash-1017权重，支持百万token上下文，编程基准提升。
summary.en: DeepSeek released V4.1-Flash-1017 weights under the MIT license with a 1M-token context and better coding scores.

title.en: OpenCode discloses breach of stored AI API keys

summary.zh: OpenCode披露数据泄露，影响1.4%控制台用户存储的AI API密钥；Anthropic宣布在新斯科舍长期租用数据中心。
summary.en: OpenCode disclosed a breach affecting stored AI API keys of 1.4% of Console users; Anthropic announced a long-term Nova Scotia data-center lease.

title.zh: 沙特联军拦截两枚射向海米斯穆谢特的胡塞导弹
title.en: Coalition intercepts Houthi missiles aimed at Khamis Mushait

summary.zh: 沙特领导的联军拦截两枚胡塞武装射向海米斯穆谢特的弹道导弹。
summary.en: The Saudi-led coalition intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Khamis Mushait.

title.zh: 赫格塞思警告伊朗放弃核野心否则面临军事行动
title.en: Hegseth warns Iran to drop nuclear ambitions

summary.zh: 美国防长赫格塞思警告伊朗必须放弃核野心，否则将面临军事行动；鲁比奥对美籍摄影记者在西岸遇袭表示关切。
summary.en: Defense Secretary Hegseth warned Iran to abandon nuclear ambitions or face military action; Rubio voiced concern over an attack on a US photojournalist.

title.zh: 联合健康和强生上调业绩指引

summary.zh: 财报季中，联合健康和强生上调全年指引，罗氏和STERIS宣布交易。
summary.en: UnitedHealth and Johnson & Johnson raised guidance, while Roche and STERIS struck deals.

title.zh: 前三季度全国铁路发送旅客37.1亿人次
title.en: Rail carried 3.71 billion passengers in three quarters

summary.zh: 前三季度全国铁路发送旅客37.1亿人次，同比增长4.8%；1.3万亿元超长期特别国债发行完毕。
summary.en: China's railways carried 3.71 billion passengers in three quarters, up 4.8%; 1.3 trillion yuan of ultra-long special bonds were fully issued.

title.zh: 李强会见乌兹别克斯坦总理 签署多项合作文件
title.en: Li Qiang holds talks in Uzbekistan

summary.zh: 李强会见乌兹别克斯坦总理，双方签署多项合作文件。
summary.en: Li Qiang met Uzbekistan's prime minister and signed several cooperation documents.

summary.zh: 北京马拉松鸣枪开跑，3.2万名跑者参赛。
summary.en: About 32,000 runners started the Beijing Marathon.
